title: Chapter 11 The Arrival Of The Ji Family
content:
Chapter 11 The Arrival Of The Ji Family

At this time, everyone suddenly smelled a foul smell.

Everyone looked over and saw that the middle-aged man was actually scared to pee.

Seeing this, Mu Tianyin frowned slightly, and then waved his hand, and the middle-aged man disappeared directly on the spot.

Thrown out.

"He is not playing tricks on you, but he simply can't remember it."

Mu Tianyin said slowly.

Hearing this, everyone put away their contemptuous eyes and looked puzzled.

"Senior Tianyin, what do you mean by this? This guy has such a bad memory?"

As a cultivator, his memory will not be too bad, not to mention that he can even forget his name.

I saw Mu Tianyin continue to say slowly: "This is not his fault, but the owner of this city."

"The owner of this city may have reached an unimaginable level. Without his permission, everything he has in other people's memories can even be erased."

Hearing this, everyone stood still.

Is it so terrifying?

In an instant, some people had already begun to think of retreating.

If they go in, they might not know how they died.

"In that case, Senior Tianyin, do you mean that the lord of the previous city is the same as this one?"

A smart person asked in surprise.

However, Mu Tianyin just stared at the huge city in front of him solemnly and stopped talking.

Suddenly, everyone shut up.

But, are we just going to sit there?

We finally came here, so we can't just leave in disgrace.

At this moment, a hearty laugh rang out.

"Hahahaha, since this mysterious huge city will appear here, it must not be as simple as letting us watch. I think it may not be the right time to open the city now, so this young master plans to expand some buildings outside this city to wait for the day of opening the city."

Everyone looked over and saw a handsome young man dressed in luxurious clothes and holding a feather fan.

"It's Master Ji!"

"Master Ji? Which Master Ji?"

"Are you stupid? Isn't there only one Master Ji in the entire Tianxuan world?"

Ji Shengcai is the only son of the head of the Ji family.

The Ji family is the richest family in the entire Tianxuan world, and its family businesses are spread all over the Tianxuan world.

The strength is unknown, but everyone knows that it is very rich, very rich.

As the future heir of the Ji family, Ji Shengcai has a very high business mind.

Not long after he came here, he smelled a great business opportunity.

Now, people in his family are rushing here in an endless stream.

After hearing Master Ji's words, everyone was stunned, and then nodded silently.

If it were someone else, they would be dismissive.

No matter how well you build this place, we won't live there.

But the Ji family is different.

Everyone knows the strength of the Ji family. If the Ji family wants to turn this deserted state with a lack of spiritual energy into a holy place for cultivation, they can do it.

"Mr. Ji, are you short of manpower? I'll work with you."

At this time, someone came forward and said happily.

Hearing this, Ji Shengcai gently waved his feather fan and raised his eyebrows slightly.

"Oh? You want to work with me, then let me make it clear first. I don't have much money recently, so the wages will be very low."

Hearing this, the man was still happy.

"It's okay, Mr. Ji, I don't want wages. When the construction is completed, just give me a house."

Cough!

Suddenly, Ji Shengcai choked directly.

Looking at the smiling man in front of him, he felt so powerless for the first time.

Why don't you go and rob?

Resisting the national essence, Ji Shengcai snorted coldly, turned his head, and said: "Let's talk about this later."

Now he dared not tell his plan in advance, otherwise he would make less money.

However, the man seemed to be fearless and came to Ji Shengcai relentlessly.

"Mr. Ji, you have to think about it seriously. It's just a house. I don't think it's a big problem."

Hearing this, Ji Shengcai frowned.

Do you really think you are good-tempered?

I am too lazy to argue with you.

"Come on, pull him down."

The next moment, two strong men with deep aura appeared beside Ji Shengcai.

Divine Mansion Realm!

Two strong men in the Divine Mansion Realm protecting the way, which is enough to show Ji Shengcai's status.

"Fuck, is that man really stupid or pretending to be stupid? He is so brave."

"Haha, I guess he was blinded by desire."

"Blinded? Who was blinded?"

"......"

However, the scene of the man being thrown out was not seen.

On the contrary, the scene in front of them made everyone stunned.

The two powerful men in the Divine Mansion Realm beside Ji Shengcai were staring at the front with horrified faces, tense and sweating.

"You, you..."

Ji Shengcai also showed a trace of fear at this moment, and his body kept retreating.

Why did this inconspicuous guy in front of him have such a terrifying aura?

The next moment, the man in front of Ji Shengcai changed his figure and suddenly turned into a slightly funny old man.

"Hehehe, little kid of the Ji family, I advise you to seriously consider the proposal just now, otherwise..."

Seeing the true face of the old man, Ji Shengcai was horrified.

He, who is he?

For a moment, because he was too nervous, Ji Shengcai couldn't even remember the identity of the person in front of him.

However, Mu Tianyin below saw the old man's face and his expression changed drastically.

"You, are you Chen Gui?!"

Hearing Mu Tianyin's scream.

Everyone was stunned for a moment and immediately retreated one after another, with horrified eyes on their faces.

Chen Gui, a person from 100,000 years ago.

He has no sense of justice and is a villain who will repay him, but such a person has entered the realm of life and become a figure at the top of the pyramid of the Tianxuan World.

And later, he disappeared into the eyes of the world.

They all thought this guy was dead.

Unexpectedly, he is still alive.

Hearing the word Chen Gui, Ji Shengcai's face turned a little pale. He naturally knew Chen Gui very well. Although his family was not afraid, he was not in his family now.

And who knows whether such a person will care about the power behind him?

"Senior Chen Gui, I have no idea about Mount Tai."

Ji Shengcai gave a quick gift and burst into tears.

Such a person, let alone a house, he will give him a gift even if he is a building.

"Senior, after the juniors have built a house, I will definitely arrange it for you immediately."

"Haha, is that right? But now I have changed my mind. I want ten sets."

Chen Gui looked at Ji Shengcai who was trembling in front of him and said coldly.

Upon hearing this, Ji Shengcai's face changed drastically.

Sure enough, this old guy is not such a peaceful master.

"That, that,"

Just as Ji Shengcai was about to compromise, a cold voice suddenly sounded from the void.

"Chen Gui, my Ji family is not that easy to bully."

boom!

Suddenly, a terrifying pressure swept across the sky.

The next moment, under the horrified eyes of everyone, the space cracked, and an illusory middle-aged man slowly stepped out of it.

Fate and unity!

"Dad, you're here!"

When Ji Shengcai saw the middle-aged man, he cried.

This middle-aged man is Ji Shengcai's father and the ruler of the Ji family.

Ji Wuxuan.

One of the top experts in the Tianxuan world.

Seeing Ji Wuhui's body coming, Chen Gui's eyes suddenly showed a hint of fear.

"Haha, you're pretty good at protecting your baby."

Above the void, Ji Wuhui looked at Chen Gui coldly without saying a word.

After a long time, Chen Gui sneered and looked at Ji Shengcai and said, "Boy, don't forget my house."

Immediately, Chen Gui disappeared directly from the spot.

Everyone breathed a sigh of relief when they saw Chen Gui leave.

If these two powerful people in the life-combination realm fight here, they have no other way except to run.

Fortunately, Chen Gui compromised.

After all, Chen Gui is just one person, and Ji Wuhui represents a force.

The conflict now will not benefit Chen Gui at all.

"Dad."

Seeing Ji Wuhui walking towards him, Ji Shengcai smiled bitterly.

"Okay, it's just a house. Compared to your safety, ten houses are worth it."

Hearing this, Ji Shengcai's eyes suddenly turned red.

It's better for your own father.

Everyone around looked at the warm scene in front of them, and their back grooves were broken.

Why is this not my father?

This young master Ji is really good at reincarnation.

Ji Shengcai was Ji Wuhui’s son when he was old, and he was also an only son, so he was a person who loved him all.

Everyone knows this.
